text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: deployment rollout 2026-03-15T02:17Z -> eu-west cluster. Canary tier observing error-rate spike ~12% 5xx, latency surge. Auto-fallback did not trigger.
Alice (oncall): saw it, I'm on it. grabbing traces + canary logs.
Ben (eng-runtime): quick note — this rollout included the new KV-prefetch kernel. rolling back that kernel was gated by fflag-2026-prefetch.
Maya (prod-sre): can we temporarily flip the flag? If rollout has bad kernel, kill flag to stop canary traffic.
Alice (oncall): trying flag kill. Using console to set fflag-2026-prefetch=false for eu-west canary group.
Alice (oncall): command I ran: `rdctl flags set fflag-2026-prefetch false --env eu-west --scope canary`
incident-bot: Action logged: flag change by Alice at 02:21Z.
Cody (support): customers on eu-west are reporting brief timeouts in chat flows. Not seeing wide data-plane outages but a few elevated error reports. Collecting example request IDs.
Ben (eng-runtime): logs show OOM-ish traces in kernel init path, but only for sequences > 1024 tokens. Canary traffic typically shorter; weird. Could be a race with kv-mgr.
Sam (eng-platform): I'm pausing the rest of the rollout and disabling autoscale bursts to avoid compounding the noise.
Alice (oncall): paused full rollout at 02:23Z (`rdctl rollouts pause 2026-03-15-euwest`).
Maya (prod-sre): good. Next step: if flag kill doesn't reduce errors in 5m, roll back the canary to previous model-kernel combo.
Alice (oncall): 02:27Z update: error-rate down to ~2.1% after flag flip. Latency trending back to normal.
Ben (eng-runtime): confirms backend KV cache warm-up is stable now. I still want a rollback candidate prepped in case we see regression later. Preparing `variant-v1.14` for rollback.
Cody (support): passing this to CS triage: summary + impacted customers list. No major SLA breaches flagged yet.
Maya (prod-sre): agree keep watch. I'll set a 30m monitoring watch and alert if >4% errors or P95 latency > 600ms.
Sam (eng-platform): opened ticket INF-7823 to track the rollout gating logic that failed to auto-fallback. Linking Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/eu-west-rollout?orgId=1
Alice (oncall): handing off to Ben for deeper postmortem and follow-up. I'm going offline in 10m for handover.
Ben (eng-runtime): I'll take it. My immediate actions: reproduce locally with long sequences, run the kernel with additional debug. If we need to rollback, I'll execute `rdctl rollout rollback 2026-03-15-euwest --to variant-v1.14`.
incident-bot: Handoff logged: Alice -> Ben at 02:36Z. On-call notes: flag kill worked; remain in watch for 30 minutes.
Alice (oncall): thanks team. Leaving detailed notes in the incident doc: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-15-euwest-prefetch.
Ben (eng-runtime): will follow up with root cause hypothesis and postmortem timeline. tagging Maya for SRE metrics review.
Maya (prod-sre): will pull alert history and customer impact window. Cody, can you collate affected customer IDs for the 02:15–02:30Z window?
Cody (support): on it, will DM list and add to the incident doc.
Ben (eng-runtime): quick next steps: collect heap profiles, enable extra kv-mgr logs (verbose), run stress for sequences 1k-2k. I'll update in this thread.
Alice (oncall): :white_check_mark: stabilization confirmed at 02:45Z. Leaving monitoring watch to Ben. Good handoff.
incident-bot: Incident thread will be auto-archived after 7 days unless labeled for long-term postmortem.
